description: The IES Virtual Environment (VE) is Integrated Environmental Solutions' integrated suite for whole-building performance simulation, rooted in building physics, for designers, engineers, owners and operators working on design, retrofit and operation. IES presents it as an all-in-one platform for all skill levels, trusted by architects and engineers, with global compliance and local expertise, fast visual HVAC and energy modelling, and BIM and CAD interoperability; IESVE 2026 aims to take building performance and mechanical engineers from geometry to defensible results faster. Companion products are IES Live, for building decarbonisation and operational energy management that benchmarks real against optimal performance and tracks net-zero plans, and IES Sync for Revit, a native transfer from Revit to the VE with built-in geometry validation that IES says cuts model rebuild time by at least half. Coverage: generic; the site has regional pages for countries in Europe, North America, Asia, the Middle East and Oceania. Access: trial or demo, downloads and weather data through the site. Licence: commercial. Caveats: the home page lists no prices, and performance claims are the vendor's own. Simulation uses: energy compliance, HVAC design, overheating and retrofit studies, and calibrated operational twins with IES Live. Related records: DesignBuilder, EnergyPlus and Pollination, which exports IES VE models.
